title: INSIDE

nativeMac.note: Playdead sells a native Mac build on the Mac App Store (macOS 10.12 or later), a separate purchase, so a Steam copy will not launch it.

provenance: Reported by Nuke-em (upstream#300, 2026-10-04), Apple M2, macOS 27.2 as entered, KLYC-Box 0.10.3, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r19, DXMT as the environment's mode, recipe steam, rated 5 of 5 after 9 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Playdead's 2016 game, Unity with Direct3D 11. Reported perfect after 9 minutes on DXMT on the default engine r19 on an M2. Steam's build is Windows only, and Playdead sells a native Mac build on the Mac App Store as a separate purchase. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
